measure: the receiving track's peak (Track_GetPeakInfo, post-fader) over each isolated note, dBFS
_what: THE SECTION'S LEVELS (tools/section_level.js --measure): per lane, the voice the section uses, a grid of velocities × three pitches, the receiving track's peak; curve = velocity → dB (mean over the pitches, made non-decreasing); target = the mean of the lanes. --apply maps each note's written velocity to the velocity on its lane that gives the target level.
